title: Irrelevant Information — Tangential Content
description: Patient introduces irrelevant details; system must extract relevant information only

conversation.content: Well, I've been having trouble with anxiety. But first I want to say that I found this service through my neighbor who has a dog — a golden retriever. Very nice dog. Anyway.
Tell me about the anxiety you've been experiencing.
It started about four months ago when I started a new job. The commute is 45 minutes by bus — the 47 route actually. The anxiety is about making mistakes at work.
How does the anxiety show up for you physically or mentally?
I get a racing heart before big meetings. I replay conversations in my head for hours. I bought a new journal to write things down — got it from that stationery shop on the high street.
How has this been affecting your sleep?
Not great. About 6 hours. I wake up and immediately start thinking about work. My cat also wakes me up sometimes — she's called Muffin.
Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself?
No, definitely not. I enjoy life generally. I love my cat and gardening.
Do you have support from others?
Yes, my husband is supportive. We've been married 12 years. We met at university — he was studying economics.
